blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three of the four Filipinos injured in an attack at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, remained in intensive care on Monday, with at least one in critical condition, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said. The fourth Filipino had been discharged from the hospital but would continue to receive medical monitoring and assistance, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said during a press briefing. The discharged patient had sustained injuries in the lumbar area and burn injuries but was deemed well enough to leave the hospital. “[W]e will monitor the situation and assist him in […]...
